stem: Which sentence should come before sentence 16 to serve as a topic sentence for the fourth paragraph (sentences 16-18)?

options.label: A
options.text: Anyone who has spent time in an urban heat island knows that the stifling heat can be unbearable.

options.label: B
options.text: Research centers are beginning to pay closer attention to areas designated as urban heat islands.

options.label: C
options.text: Urban heat islands can be located by measuring the temperatures in the city and surrounding areas.

options.label: D
options.text: The higher temperatures found in urban heat islands are concerning for a number of reasons.
